entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Sales', 'Support', or 'Returns' to be connected to the right department.
Connecting you to a returns specialist now.
Hi, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi Sarah... I... I need to return something. I'm just so disappointed.
I'm sorry to hear that. I can definitely look into that for you. Can I get your name and the item you're calling about?
My name is Mark Peterson. I bought a pair of your cycling shoes a couple of months ago.
Okay, Mark, I see your account. I'm sorry the shoes didn't work out. To make sure I understand, can you tell me what specifically is the issue with them?
They just... they give me terrible blisters. Every single time I ride. I've tried adjusting the cleats, wearing different socks, everything. I just can't wear them anymore.
Oh, that sounds really uncomfortable. Getting blisters is definitely no way to enjoy a ride. Let me just pull up the purchase date here to check on the return eligibility.

I really hope you can help. I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for years and I saved up for these specific cycling shoes. I was just really hoping I could get a refund. I really needed this money back, especially with the holidays coming up.

I completely understand. Let's see... okay, I see they were delivered 81 days ago. You are well within our 90-day return window, so I can absolutely process that full refund for you. No problem at all.
Oh, wow, really? That's... that's a huge relief. Thank you so much, Sarah. I was so worried I'd just be stuck with them.

Of course, Mark. We want you to be happy with your gear. I'm emailing you a pre-paid return label right now. Just pack the shoes back in a box, attach the label, and drop it off at any shipping center. Once we receive it, the refund will be processed back to your original payment method.
That's perfect. You've been so helpful. This really made my day.
I'm so glad I could help you out. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
